content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant I: B.A., LL.B./LL.B. or equivalent Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Good knowledge of latest national and international research trends and developments in the field of IPR. Ability to conceptualize and organize academic programs like workshops, capacity building seminars, conferences, brainstorming sessions, etc. Fluency in English language and proficiency in computer knowledge (MS Office, AI-based activities, plagiarism software, etc.) Project Assistant: 10+2 with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) from an Indian Board

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Indore Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 01 October 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue well before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Assistant I post and one vacancy for the Project Assistant post, totaling two vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant I position?
faq.answer: For the Research Assistant I position, candidates need a B.A., LL.B./LL.B. or equivalent degree with at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant I post will receive a salary of ₹47,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Indian Institute of Technology Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
